description: This file implements the TpmRemoteProvisioningContext class, which manages TPM-based remote provisioning, including key generation, device info creation, cryptographic operations, and CSR building within the Cuttlefish project.

classes.name: TpmRemoteProvisioningContext
classes.description: A class that manages TPM-based remote provisioning, including key generation, device info creation, cryptographic operations, and CSR building.

methods.name: TpmRemoteProvisioningContext
methods.description: Constructor initializing the context with a resource manager and generating initial keys.

methods.name: DeriveBytesFromHbk
methods.description: Derives a byte sequence from the Hardware Bound Key (HBK) using HKDF.

methods.name: CreateDeviceInfo
methods.description: Creates a device information map with various device attributes.

methods.name: GenerateBcc
methods.description: Generates a BCC (Boot Configuration Chain) key pair and associated data.

methods.name: SetSystemVersion
methods.description: Sets the OS version and patch level information.

methods.name: SetVerifiedBootInfo
methods.description: Sets verified boot state, bootloader state, and digest.

methods.name: BuildProtectedDataPayload
methods.description: Builds a payload for protected data, including signing and BCC chain.

methods.name: GenerateHmacSha256
methods.description: Generates an HMAC-SHA256 digest using TPM context.

methods.name: GetHwInfo
methods.description: Fills hardware info response with device-specific data.

methods.name: BuildCsr
methods.description: Builds a Certificate Signing Request (CSR) with device info and keys.
